title: 第3章 你们不怕死！我怕啊！
slug: 我在致郁番里画热血番
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

什么换男主？

田小西都给搞懵了。

她下意识地先看了一眼后台，在看到后台时，她惊愕地发现，整个后台修改功能被锁定了。

后台漫画竟然还自己多出来了一话。

“这怎么可能？”

“这难道是我画的？”

田小西倒吸了口凉气，努力闭着眼睛回想，不对啊！没画过啊！

怎么会多出一个第六话？

明明不是才画到女主角刚出场吗？

她心底有种见了鬼的惊恐，但是又有些期待，难不成是网站给她找了个枪手？

网站这么负责吗？

连她这种扑街漫画也找枪手代替？

抱着想看看枪手能画成什么样的心态，田小西点开了新的第六话。

第六话里。

一个之前完全没印象的叫贺舟的角色占据了整个篇幅。

整个第六话，完全都是画的他一个人的事。

比如主动争取成为江黛的同桌。

每天骚扰小猫，把江黛弄得有些应激，见到他就害怕应激，甚至是哈气。

两人的互动十分生动又有趣。

最后停在了贺舟画的一个奶牛猫简笔画，和一个穿着警服的猫的简笔画情节上。

小猫不仅好奇地趴在课桌旁边，探头看他画画，还第一次跟他有了对话。

评论里也终于出现了第一条正向评论。

【用户3452：这NPC的小人画得真好，这个小猫画得还挺有意思的。】

“……”

有脏东西！

她得早点太监！

雨已经连续下了三天。

在下雨的时候，大家格外浮躁，一边看着时间，一边沉默，每一个都很焦躁。

贺舟趴在桌子上，看着桌上的内容。

画面里。

一群老鼠深夜搬空粮仓，而黑猫警长接到报案之后带领警士展开追捕。

画了三天，才刚画满一张大纸。

他整个脑袋又一次嗡嗡嗡，如同浑身的能量都被抽干了。

“……”

Page (1/3)

Why change the male lead?

Tian Xiaoxi was confused.

She subconsciously glanced at the background first. When she saw the background, she was shocked to find that the entire background modification function was locked.

The backstage comic even added an extra chapter of its own.

"How is this possible?"

"Did I draw this?"

Tian Xiaoxi took a breath and tried to think back with her eyes closed, it was wrong!I’ve never painted before!

Why is there an extra sixth chapter?

Isn't it obvious that the heroine has just appeared?

She felt terrified that she had seen a ghost, but also looked forward to it. Could it be that the website found a gunman for her?

Is the website so responsible?

Even a street-fighting comic like her needs a gunman to replace her?

With the mentality of wanting to see what the gunman could draw, Tian Xiaoxi clicked on the new sixth episode.

In Chapter 6.

A character named He Zhou, whom I had no impression of before, occupies the entire page.

The entire sixth episode is entirely about him.

For example, actively strive to become Jiang Dai's deskmate.

Harassing the kittens every day made Jiang Dai a little stressed. When she saw him, she was afraid of stress and even got angry.

The interaction between the two is very lively and interesting.

Finally, I stopped at a simple drawing of a cow and a cat drawn by He Zhou, and a simple drawing of a cat in a police uniform.

Not only did the kitten curiously lie down next to the desk, leaning its head to watch him draw, but it also had a conversation with him for the first time.

The first positive comment finally appeared in the comments.

[User 3452: This NPC villain is really well drawn, and this kitten is quite interesting to draw.】

"..."

There's something dirty!

She needs to be eunuch early!

It has been raining for three consecutive days.

When it rains, everyone is particularly impetuous. They watch the time and remain silent. Everyone is very anxious.

He Zhou lay on the table and looked at the contents on the table.

in the screen.

A group of rats emptied the granary late at night, and Sheriff Black Cat led the police on a hunt after receiving a report.

After three days of painting, I just finished painting a large piece of paper.

His whole head was buzzing again, as if all the energy in his body had been drained.
